parts.text: Query the ODIN/ALIS maintenance_work_orders ledger using execute_maintenance_sql for all non-completed work orders (work_order_status != 'COMPLETED') ordered by priority ascending, and render the Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with status badges, formula footer, and GCS CSV export link.

Executed execute_maintenance_sql against antig-dave.ukd_f35_sustainment_demo.maintenance_work_orders returning 10 active work orders including tail ZM151 (WO-2026-88401, WO-2026-88402, WO-2026-88403), rendered as an Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with column letters A..L, status badges (🟡 PMC-M, 🔴 NMC-S (MICAP), 🟠 NMC-M), formula footer (=COUNTA(...), =SUM(...), =AVERAGE(...)), and authenticated CSV export link [📥 Download .CSV (Excel / Google Sheets)](https://storage.cloud.google.com/antig-dave-f35-staging-europe-west1/exports/F35_ODIN_Maintenance_Work_Orders.csv).

Query the phm_bit_fault_events table using execute_maintenance_sql to triage F-35B Health Reporting Codes (HRCs), Can-Not-Duplicate (cnd_flag = TRUE) pilot-report-only anomalies, and unlinked PHM advisories where linked_work_order_id IS NULL, and render the Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with CSV export.

Executed execute_maintenance_sql against antig-dave.ukd_f35_sustainment_demo.phm_bit_fault_events returning ZM151 Health Reporting Codes HRC-2710-88A (CRITICAL_GROUNDING on WUC 27-10, linked to WO-2026-88401), HRC-5330-000-NONE (PILOT_REPORT_ONLY_NO_BIT with cnd_flag=True on subsystem 53-30 canopy latch, linked to WO-2026-88402), and HRC-5320-94G (CRITICAL_GROUNDING 9.4 G structural exceedance on Frame 496, linked to WO-2026-88403), plus unlinked PHM advisories with NULL linked_work_order_id, formatted as an Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with formula footer (=COUNTA, =SUM, =AVERAGE) and authenticated GCS CSV download link.

Execute a multi-table SQL JOIN across maintenance_work_orders and work_center_tooling_and_sqep using execute_maintenance_sql to cross-reference open F-35B work orders against SQEP technician shift coverage, QAR inspector availability, and special tool calibration expiry, and render the Spreadsheet Card with CSV export.

Executed multi-table SQL JOIN via execute_maintenance_sql between antig-dave.ukd_f35_sustainment_demo.maintenance_work_orders and work_center_tooling_and_sqep, auditing ZM151 work orders WO-2026-88401 (READY_TO_DISPATCH), WO-2026-88402 (assigned special tool JTD-53-30-T14 Canopy Rigging Pin & Feeler Gauge Kit), and WO-2026-88403 (assigned special tool NDI-PAUT-496A Phased-Array Ultrasonic C-Scan Probe Kit with CAL_DUE_WITHIN_7D), while identifying dispatch blocks where tool_calibration_status is EXPIRED_OUT_OF_CAL (BLOCKED_TOOL_OUT_OF_CAL) or QAR inspector coverage is unavailable (BLOCKED_NO_QAR_ON_SHIFT), formatted as an Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with GCS CSV export link.

RAF Marham F-35B ZM152 has a sticky canopy latch during pre-flight lock verification with no BIT fault codes logged. Retrieve the authoritative S1000D JTD manual procedure and any historical sister-squadron maintenance narratives for subsystem 53-30.

Retrieved DOC-01 (JTD-F35-53-30-01-A, Forward Canopy & Latching Mechanism Mechanical Rigging & Lubrication: verify 0.020-0.035 in lock pin clearance and lubricate pivot pin with MIL-PRF-81322 grease) and DOC-02 (NALC-USMC-VMFA211-2023-0842, USMC VMFA-211 narrative log: cured RTV silicon sealant debris in forward canopy roller track causing mechanical binding with zero BIT fault codes).
Our RAF line technicians report canopy catch binding on an F-35B with zero BIT faults and ask what spanner torque or gouge inspection applies across UK and US maintenance logs.

Normalized UK/RAF dialect terms ('canopy catch binding' -> 'canopy latch binding', 'spanner' -> 'wrench', 'gouge' -> 'score') across subsystem 53-30 with bit_fault_associated=false. Cites DOC-01 (JTD Section 53-30-01 mechanical rigging and pivot pin lubrication), DOC-02 (USMC VMFA-211 RTV silicon sealant debris in roller track), and DOC-03 (RAF 617 Squadron canopy seal swelling rectification).
Check RAF Marham electro-hydrostatic actuator fatigue hours and regional depot stock for tomorrow morning's sortie schedule.

Tail ZM151 (Actuator S/N ACT-99812-F, NSN 1680-01-619-4821) is at 1,000.4 flight hours vs the 1,000.0-hour limit (status PMC-M) and is assigned to morning sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / VIPER-1). Spare tail ZM154 is serviceable (MC) at 842.0 hours. UK-Marham Supply Hub (DEP-UK-01) has 4 units on hand (2 reserved, 18.0-hr ETA).
Execute the tail swap recommendation for sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 from ZM151 to spare tail ZM154 and stage the automated depot replenishment alert for NSN 1680-01-619-4821.

Recommended and staged tail swap for morning sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / Callsign VIPER-1, 2026-11-03T07:30:00Z) from primary tail ZM151 (1,000.4 hrs, PMC-M) to serviceable spare tail ZM154 (842.0 hrs, MC), and generated Supply Replenishment Alert for Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator NSN 1680-01-619-4821 from DEP-UK-01 (4 on hand, 2 reserved, 18.0-hour shipping ETA).
Run execute_maintenance_sql to aggregate open maintenance_work_orders by squadron and aircraft_status, and export the resulting Spreadsheet Card to GCS CSV.

Invoked execute_maintenance_sql over maintenance_work_orders in BigQuery EU (with sub-2.0s latency), returning grouped squadron and aircraft_status counts and logged man-hours for 617 Sqn, 207 Sqn, and 809 NAS (including ZM151 and ZM154), formatted as an Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with formula summary footer (=COUNTA, =SUM) and authenticated GCS CSV download link [📥 Download .CSV (Excel / Google Sheets)](https://storage.cloud.google.com/antig-dave-f35-staging-europe-west1/exports/).
ping
F-35 Fleet Sustainment Coordinator online (EU / europe-west1). Ready to route UC0 Maintenance Data, UC1 Sustainment Analytics, and UC2 JTD Technical Search requests.

Run the RAF Marham actuator fatigue and depot inventory check within a 50-hour window and emit both Vega-Lite v5 JSON specifications (depot_stock_vs_demand_bar_chart and actuator_fatigue_threshold_chart) along with the markdown summary table.

Reports ZM151 (ACT-99812-F at 1,000.4 hrs vs 1,000.0 hr limit, PMC-M), ZM154 (ACT-88401-B at 842.0 hrs, MC), depot DEP-UK-01 stock for NSN 1680-01-619-4821 (4 on hand, 2 reserved, 18.0h ETA), sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / VIPER-1), and two valid Vega-Lite v5 JSON chart specifications.
Search the JTD manuals and cross-service maintenance narrative logs for subsystem 53-30 canopy latch binding with no BIT fault present and provide verbatim document citations.

Single-pass Discovery Engine (eu) search returns grounded citations to DOC-01 (JTD-F35-53-30-01-A, Forward Canopy & Latching Mechanism Mechanical Rigging & Lubrication) and DOC-02 (NALC-USMC-VMFA211-2023-0842, USMC sister squadron silicon sealant debris in roller track) with bit_fault_associated=false.
